lede: Use New Zealand Honey Co. discount code {code} for {pct} off raw Manuka honey from New Zealand Honey Co., a honey company based in Mount Maunganui, New Zealand, that ships to the US from its own warehouses. Below: what each UMF grade costs with the code, when the Black Friday sale or Subscribe & Save is the better deal, and the shipping and return rules.
cart_tip: Prices on the US store are in US dollars, and shipping is free on orders over $30.

sections.h2: New Zealand Honey Co. prices with the code

parts.small: Regular prices in US dollars on newzealandhoneyco.com on November 26, 2026, before the Black Friday sale is applied. Prices with the code are rounded to the nearest cent, so checkout may differ by 1 cent.

parts: UMF is an independent grading mark for New Zealand Manuka honey, and MGO is the amount of methylglyoxal the lab measured. A higher grade costs more: the same 250g jar runs from $18.88 at UMF 10+ to $600 at UMF 30+. If you mainly want Manuka honey for your tea or toast, the lower grades are the cheapest way in.

sections.h2: 1. Compare the Black Friday sale with the code
parts: When we checked on November 26, 2026, the home page ran a Black Friday sale until Tuesday, December 1 (3pm ET): 30% off the 17.6 oz (500g) jars, 20% off the 8.8 oz (250g) jars and 10% off the 4.4 oz (125g) jars, for UMF 15+ to 26+, plus a free Manuka Care Kit (valued at $40 by the brand) on orders of $150 or more, one per order while stocks last.

On those jars the sale is bigger than our {pct}, so a 500g UMF 20+ jar is about $76.22 at 30% off instead of $97.99 with {code}. Stores often let only one discount apply, so add your jars to the cart, try {code}, and keep whichever total is lower. For UMF 10+ and the kits, which the sale line doesn't name, the code is the one to try.

figure.alt: 250g jar of New Zealand Honey Co. Manuka honey UMF 15+ MGO 514+

parts: The big jar is the cheaper buy per gram at every grade. UMF 15+ is $38.88 for 250g but $66.88 for 500g, so the second 250g costs $28. At UMF 20+, 500g is $108.88 against $127.76 for two 250g jars. The 500g also comes in a squeezy bottle at the same price as the jar.

sections.h2: 3. Subscribe & Save if you buy it regularly
parts: Subscribe & Save delivers every 4, 8 or 12 weeks. The product pages showed 20% off from the first order, and the brand says the discount grows to up to 25% the longer you stay. You can skip, change or cancel from your account, but changes need to be made at least 48 hours before an order is processed. A code may not stack with the subscription price, so compare the totals in the cart.

sections.h2: 4. Build a bundle or sign up for emails
parts: The menu offers a build-your-own bundle at 20% off and two ready-made kits (the Daily Ritual Kit was $76.88 against $109.69 for its parts). The site also offers 15% off your next order when you sign up for its emails, which is more than our {pct} if you were going to order twice anyway.

Shipping is free on orders over $30 USD to countries with tracked delivery, including the US, Canada and Australia; smaller orders pay a small shipping charge. The brand lists 1 to 3 business days for the US, 7 to 10 for Canada and 4 to 7 for Australia. Every order gets a tracking number, and taxes or duties outside the US are the buyer's to pay.

Its refund policy allows returns within 30 days, but only for unused, unopened items in their original condition, with proof of purchase, and you pay the return shipping. Opened food can't be sent back unless it arrived damaged or defective. Subscription orders follow the same rules. Like all honey, it isn't suitable for babies under 12 months.
